# UC-LEARN2 — PingOne MCP Inspector

**Track:** learn  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  


## Buyer Story

See the hosted PingOne MCP server for real — browse its live tool schemas and invoke them.

## PingOne Solution

Calls the hosted PingOne MCP server over HTTP; tool schemas are fetched live and grouped by resource (Environments, Applications, Users, Populations).

## How to Run

**Trigger:** Trigger (link): `{"type":"link","path":"/pingone-mcp-inspector","label":"Open PingOne MCP Inspector"}`  
**Expected outcome:** `LIVE_MCP_TOOLS`

## What to Say

> This is the real hosted PingOne MCP server — its tools, its schemas, invoked live from the demo.
